notes.title: Parabolus Two Steam Game Fesitival
notes.notes:
[b]Parabolus Two [/b]

Shoot your way across the galaxy in this thrilling adventure! It’s the sci-fi shooter which blends old school game mechanics with modern story driven cinematic experiences. Unlock the mystery of strange events all over the Milky Way and find out who (or what) is behind them. 

A fusion of retro gameplay with modern design, the demo contains three levels that take place early in the game, each one with a variety of objectives to complete. While only containing a slice of what's on offer in the full game, it will definitely give you an appetite for some Parabolus action!

The full game contains more than forty levels taking place in many different environments from a harsh mining planet to a freezing ball of ice which somehow seems to be colder than deep space.  The game is geared towards a more sophisticated approach than your typical shooter but nobody will stop you if you decide to go guns blazing.

[b]Who made this?[/b]
Parabolus Two is the brainchild of 40 Pound Tiger, a small studio based in London, Engand. So small in fact, it would need to double in size to be considered a two man outfit. 

2020 is a great time to be making games with so many creative avenues available to people. However, creating a game is not easy and I am pround to finally be able to present my work here at the festival for you to enjoy. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bjYwPqHl_U4
